captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional cafe. Not a client project.

Plenty of cafe sites open with a photo slider, hide the menu in a PDF and leave the hours at the very bottom. People just want to know: are you open, what is on, how do I order.

So we put today’s hours and an open-now line at the top, one button to order, the menu as real text and the map one scroll down.

Does your site do this? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional Melbourne cafe homepage, rebuilt for the phone.

The old version looks lovely and answers nothing. Four photos to swipe, the menu in a 6 MB PDF, an Instagram feed loading before anything useful, and the opening hours at the very bottom.

The new one leads with today’s hours and an open-now line, has one button to order, shows the menu as real text, and keeps the map one scroll down.

Not a client project. If your site does any of this, I am happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
